title: 22 · born_of_fire · Born of His Own Fire
lines: Shiva once threw his own anger into the ocean.
It did not go out. It grew up.
Indra, king of heaven, once insulted a ragged stranger on the road to Kailash.
And his third eye began to open.
But the fire had already left his eye.
So he threw it into the sea.
The ocean could not put it out.
It could only hold it. And the fire became a child.
The boy cried so loud that the creator came to look.
He was named Jalandhara: the one the water carries.
He had Shiva's strength, and none of Shiva's stillness.
He took the heavens. He took the earth.
And then someone described Parvati to him.
He sent a messenger to Kailash.
You already know what was waiting at that door.
The anger you throw away comes back with your own face. Burn it clean. That is sadhana.
